On certain days, the dry river of the {wiki:Zao Steppe} flows again and fills with fish. While it is active you can fish for {item:Sandfish|Sandfishes}, and the first one you catch gives you the achievement **Desert Fisher**.
In the dry steppe of Zao, a river full of fish suddenly starts to flow.

When the world change is active, you hear messages like these:

Take the dwarves' **Steamship**: {npc:Brodrosch}, far below Kazordoon (210 gp), or {npc:Gurbasch}, 8 floors below Cormaya, near Edron (110 gp). Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine} and {key:yes}. After mission 2 of the {wiki:The New Frontier Quest} the trip is 50 gp cheaper.
In Farmine, go **east** of {npc:Ongulf} and pass the sealed doors. Stand on the switch and use the **right lever**: the lift takes you to the surface of the mountain.
Climbing down the mountain to the Zao Steppe

On the surface follow the path **east**, going down the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or stacking parcels/boxes). When you leave the mountain, at {coord:33085,31532,7}, you are already in the {wiki:Zao Steppe}.
Exit of the mountain passage (entrance to the Zao Steppe)
Going to the Zao Steppe river
On the steppe, look for the dry riverbed of the {wiki:Zao Steppe}, which now has running water. The steppe is east of the Farmine mountain and south of the {wiki:Dragonblaze Peaks}.
On the steppe there are {creature:Sandcrawler|Sandcrawlers}, {creature:Gnarlhound|Gnarlhounds} and orcs ({creature:Orc}, {creature:Orc Spearman}, {creature:Orc Warrior}).
Use the {item:Fishing Rod} on the river water until you catch a {item:Sandfish}. Your first Sandfish gives you the **Desert Fisher** achievement; while the river runs you can keep catching more.

Go back the same way: return to the passage at {coord:33085,31532,7}, climb the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and head **west** to the lift, which takes you back to Farmine. There talk to {npc:Thorgrin} on the Steamship and say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} (210 gp) or {key:cormaya} (110 gp) and {key:yes}.
